focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期临近，中国出口企业需紧急核查产品碳足迹数据
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征收阶段。近期欧盟委员会发布过渡期数据填报常见问题指南，强调进口商须提交嵌入碳排放数据，否则将面临默认值惩罚。中国钢铁、铝、化肥、电力、氢等高碳行业出口企业应尽快建立产品级碳核算体系，与欧盟进口商协同完成数据申报，并评估碳成本对定价的影响。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会税务与海关同盟总司 · 2026.10.14
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transition Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Verify Product Carbon Footprint Data
focus.summary_en: The transitional period of the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) will end by the end of 2026, with the definitive regime starting in 2027. The European Commission recently issued guidance on common reporting issues, stressing that importers must submit embedded emissions data or face default-value penalties. Chinese exporters in high-carbon sectors such as steel, aluminium, fertilisers, electricity and hydrogen should promptly establish product-level carbon accounting systems, coordinate with EU importers on data reporting, and assess the impact of carbon costs on pricing.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission, Directorate-General for Taxation and Customs Union · 2026.10.14

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭首例承认中国法院商事判决，明确互惠关系认定标准
case.summary: 新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）近期在一宗中资企业合同纠纷中，依据《新加坡国际商事法庭法》承认并执行了中国内地法院的商事判决。判决指出，中新两国虽无双边司法协助条约，但中国法院此前已基于互惠原则承认新加坡法院判决，故本案满足互惠要求。该案为中国企业在新加坡申请执行内地判决提供了重要先例，建议企业在合同中明确选择SICC管辖并保留互惠证据。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭 · 2026年9月
case.title_en: SICC Recognises Chinese Commercial Judgment for First Time, Clarifies Reciprocity Test
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recently recognised and enforced a commercial judgment from mainland China in a contract dispute involving a Chinese company, pursuant to the SICC Act. The court held that although no bilateral judicial assistance treaty exists between China and Singapore, Chinese courts had previously recognised Singaporean judgments on reciprocity grounds, thus satisfying the reciprocity requirement. This case offers a significant precedent for Chinese enterprises seeking to enforce mainland judgments in Singapore. Companies are advised to designate SICC jurisdiction in contracts and retain evidence of reciprocity.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Commercial Court · September 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境商事纠纷“一站式”在线解纷平台，支持港澳调解员入驻
policy.summary: 广东省司法厅与港澳法律部门联合推出粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷一站式在线解纷平台，整合调解、仲裁、公证等法律服务，允许港澳调解员和仲裁员在线入驻。平台支持中英葡三语，并与港澳司法机构实现数据互通。企业可通过平台在线申请调解、选择港澳调解员，并申请跨境公证文书电子流转。此举旨在降低跨境解纷成本，提升大湾区法治化营商环境。
policy.source: 来源：广东省司法厅 · 2026年10月
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches One-Stop Online Dispute Resolution Platform for Cross-Border Commercial Disputes, Welcoming Hong Kong and Macao Mediators
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice, together with Hong Kong and Macao legal authorities, has launched a one-stop online dispute resolution platform for cross-border commercial disputes in the Greater Bay Area. The platform integrates mediation, arbitration, and notarisation services, and allows Hong Kong and Macao mediators and arbitrators to join online. It supports Chinese, English, and Portuguese, and enables data interoperability with Hong Kong and Macao judicial institutions. Enterprises can apply for mediation online, select Hong Kong or Macao mediators, and request electronic transfer of cross-border notarial documents. The initiative aims to reduce dispute resolution costs and enhance the rule-of-law business environment in the Greater Bay Area.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice · October 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中国科技企业需重构跨境架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部近期拟将对外投资审查范围扩大至人工智能、量子计算和先进半导体领域，并强化对通过第三国间接投资的穿透监管。中国科技企业应尽快排查现有跨境投资架构，评估是否涉及受限技术领域；在美投资或与美国主体设立合资企业时，应提前进行合规尽调，并考虑采用许可、服务贸易等替代模式。同时，建议企业建立动态合规台账，跟踪政策更新，必要时申请豁免或寻求专业法律意见。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 编辑部 · 2026.10.14
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: US Outbound Investment Screening Expands, Chinese Tech Firms Must Restructure Cross-Border Frameworks
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury Department recently proposed expanding outbound investment screening to artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and advanced semiconductors, and strengthening look-through regulation of indirect investments via third countries. Chinese technology companies should promptly review their existing cross-border investment structures to assess whether they touch restricted technology sectors. When investing in the US or forming joint ventures with US entities, they should conduct advance compliance due diligence and consider alternative models such as licensing and trade in services. Companies are also advised to maintain dynamic compliance records, track policy updates, and where necessary seek exemptions or professional legal advice.
